changelog: Windows MSIX SxS Toolchain: Bundled complete companion DLLs (appxpackaging.dll, appxsip.dll, opcservices.dll) and SxS manifests, eliminating side-by-side configuration errors
Multi-Resource Self-Extraction: Extracts all embedded toolchain manifests and companion libraries together to AppData
Splash Studio Canvas Fix: Added explicit path encapsulation to prevent path retention artifacts when loading custom disk images
Zero-Clutter Packaging: Standalone single-file bundle with zero loose DLLs in root
